about: Which photograph fills each photo slot of the mock-ups: slot -> file name in mockups/photos/, a folder git IGNORES. ⛔ No photograph is committed: this repository is public and a photo's usage rights are the Owner's. A slot whose file is not in the folder shows a labelled placeholder. To preview with real photos, copy a photo into mockups/photos/ under the slot's file name (or set the slot's file name here to the photo's own name) and run `npm run build:mockups`. Each slot is used by every piece that shows it, so changing a slot's photo changes all of them; the README lists which pieces use which slot.
